text.tspan: Source: UC-29 NF1–6, A1–A3, E1–E2; BR143

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. UC-29 lists badges / frames / themes / IT materials; BR143 specifies avatars / streak-freeze items. The item scope remains inconsistent in the SRS.
